description: Report on a job started by text_to_cad, drawing_to_3d or photo_to_3d. While it runs, says so; when it is done, downloads every file (STEP, STL, 3MF for a CAD part; GLB, STL, OBJ, FBX, USDZ for a photo model) to disk and returns the paths. Free. Poll about every 30 seconds.

output_dir.description: Folder for the files. Defaults to ./techdrawai-output.

name: check_job
title: Check a 3D or CAD job
